# **12-Week Strength & Conditioning Programme (Cycle-Phased)**

## **Client Overview**
- **28, recreational lifter**
- **Severe primary dysmenorrhea (flow days 1–3: no high-intensity, Valsalva, or jumping)**
- **Regular 28-day cycle**
- **Goals:** Strength, aerobic base, metabolic conditioning, athleticism

---

## **Programme Structure**

- **Strength:** 3x/week (Full-body, cycle-phased)
- **Cardio:** 2–3x/week (steady-state, cycle-phased)
- **HIIT:** 1x/week (non-flow days only)
- **Plyometric/Power:** 1x/week (non-flow days only)
- **Nutrition:** Cycle-supportive, anti-inflammatory, energy-focused
- **1RM Test:** End of week 12, outside flow days

---

## **Cycle-Based Adjustments**

- **Flow Days (Days 1–3):**  
  - Only low-intensity, bodyweight, mobility, gentle cardio  
  - No HIIT, plyometrics, heavy lifting, or Valsalva
- **Non-Flow Days:**  
  - Full intensity for strength, HIIT, plyometrics, and cardio

---

## **Weekly Layout (Non-Flow Week Example)**

| Day      | Session Type         |
|----------|---------------------|
| Mon      | Strength A          |
| Tue      | Cardio (steady)     |
| Wed      | Strength B          |
| Thu      | Plyometric/Power    |
| Fri      | Strength C          |
| Sat      | HIIT                |
| Sun      | Cardio (optional)   |

*On flow weeks, skip HIIT and plyometrics, substitute with gentle movement or rest.*

---

## **Phase 1: Foundation & Adaptation (Weeks 1–4)**

### **Strength (3x/week)**
- **Session A:** Squat focus + Push + Core
- **Session B:** Hinge focus + Pull + Core
- **Session C:** Unilateral/Accessory + Mobility

**Sample Exercises:**
- Goblet Squat 3x10–12
- Dumbbell Bench Press 3x10–12
- Romanian Deadlift 3x10–12
- Seated Row 3x10–12
- Step-ups 3x10/leg
- Plank 3x30–40s
- Side Plank 3x20–30s/side

**Progression:** Add 2.5–5% load/week if all reps/sets are completed with good form.

---

### **Cardio (2–3x/week)**
- **Flow Days:** 20–30 min gentle walk, easy cycling, or swimming (RPE 3–4/10)
- **Non-Flow Days:** 30–35 min steady-state (RPE 5–6/10), 1x/week optional brisk walk or easy bike

---

### **HIIT (1x/week, Non-Flow Only)**
- 30s work / 60s rest x 6–8 rounds (air bike, rower, ski erg, or cycling)
- 5-min warm-up, 5-min cool-down

---

### **Plyometric/Power (1x/week, Non-Flow Only)**
- Box step-off to stick landing 3x5
- Low box jump (12–16") 3x5
- Med ball chest pass 3x6
- Med ball overhead slam 3x6
- Skater hops 3x6/side
- Med ball rotational throw 3x6/side

---

### **Flow Days (All Phases)**
- Bodyweight squats/lunges 3x10–12
- Incline or wall push-ups 3x10–12
- Bird-dogs or dead bugs 3x12
- Gentle stretching, cat-cow, child’s pose
- 20–30 min gentle walk or cycle (optional)

---

## **Phase 2: Progressive Overload & Intensification (Weeks 5–8)**

### **Strength (3x/week, Intensified)**
- **Session A (Heavy Squat):**
  - Barbell Back Squat: 1x5 @ 75–80% 1RM (top set), 3x5 @ 70–75% (back-off)
  - Barbell Bench Press: 4x6 @ 70–75%
  - Seated Row: 4x8 (challenging)
  - Plank: 3x45–50s

- **Session B (Heavy Deadlift):**
  - Barbell Deadlift: 1x5 @ 75–80% 1RM (top set), 3x5 @ 70–75% (back-off)
  - Pull-Ups/Assisted: 4x5–8 (weighted if possible)
  - Bulgarian Split Squat: 3x8/leg (moderate-heavy)
  - Side Plank: 3x30–40s/side

- **Session C (Accessory/Unilateral):**
  - Dumbbell Overhead Press: 4x8 (challenging)
  - Single-Leg RDL: 3x10/leg
  - Lat Pulldown: 3x10
  - Farmer’s Carry: 3x30m (heavy)
  - Mobility/Stretching: 10–15 min

**Progression:** Increase load 2.5–5%/week if all reps/sets are completed.

---

### **Cardio (2–3x/week)**
- **Flow Days:** 20–30 min gentle walk/cycle/swim (RPE 3–4/10)
- **Non-Flow Days:** 35–40 min steady-state (RPE 5–6/10), 1x/week 25–30 min with 10 min tempo (RPE 6–7/10)

---

### **HIIT (1x/week, Non-Flow Only)**
- 30s work / 45s rest x 8–10 rounds (air bike, rower, ski erg, cycling)
- 5-min warm-up, 5-min cool-down

---

### **Plyometric/Power (1x/week, Non-Flow Only)**
- Box jump (16–20") 4x4
- Broad jump 4x4
- Lateral bounds 4x5/side
- Med ball scoop toss 4x5
- Push press (DB or barbell) 4x5
- Med ball rotational throw 4x5/side

---

## **Phase 3: Peak Strength, Power & 1RM Test (Weeks 9–12)**

### **Strength (3x/week, Peaking)**
- **Session A (Heavy Squat):**
  - Barbell Back Squat: 1x3–5 @ 80–85% 1RM (top set), 3x5 @ 75–80% (back-off)
  - Barbell Bench Press: 4x5 @ 75–80%
  - Seated Row: 4x6–8 (heavy)
  - Plank: 3x50–60s

- **Session B (Heavy Deadlift):**
  - Barbell Deadlift: 1x3–5 @ 80–85% 1RM (top set), 3x5 @ 75–80% (back-off)
  - Pull-Ups: 4x6 (weighted if possible)
  - Bulgarian Split Squat: 3x8/leg (heavy)
  - Side Plank: 3x40–50s/side

- **Session C (Accessory/Unilateral):**
  - Dumbbell Overhead Press: 4x6–8 (heavy)
  - Single-Leg RDL: 3x8/leg
  - Lat Pulldown: 3x8–10
  - Farmer’s Carry: 3x40m (heavy)
  - Mobility/Stretching: 10–15 min

---

### **Cardio (2–3x/week)**
- **Flow Days:** 20–30 min gentle walk/cycle/swim (RPE 3–4/10)
- **Non-Flow Days:** 40–45 min steady-state (RPE 5–6/10), 1x/week 30–35 min with 2x8 min tempo (RPE 6–7/10)

---

### **HIIT (1x/week, Non-Flow Only)**
- 40s work / 60s rest x 8–10 rounds **OR** 20s work / 40s rest x 12 rounds (Tabata-style)
- 5-min warm-up, 5-min cool-down

---

### **Plyometric/Power (1x/week, Non-Flow Only)**
- Depth jump (step off 12–16" box, jump up) 4x3
- Repeated broad jumps 4x4
- Split squat jump 4x4/side

- **Taper week:** Reduce volume/intensity, focus on technique and recovery
- **Test day:**

  - Gradually build to 1RM for squat, bench, deadlift  
  - Use spotters/safety bars  
  - Rest 3–5 min between heavy attempts

## **Nutrition Plan (All Phases)**

### **General**
- **Protein:** 1.6–2.2g/kg bodyweight/day
- **Carbs:** Emphasize complex carbs, especially pre/post workout
- **Fats:** Include healthy fats (olive oil, nuts, seeds, avocado)
- **Hydration:** 2.5–3L/day

### **Cycle-Supportive Focus**
- **Flow Days:**  
  - Iron-rich foods (beef, lentils, spinach)  
  - Magnesium (pumpkin seeds, dark chocolate)  
  - Omega-3s (salmon, chia/flax seeds)  
  - Small, frequent meals if appetite is low  
  - Herbal teas (ginger, chamomile) for cramps

- **Follicular/Ovulation:**  
  - Higher complex carbs, lean protein, antioxidants  
  - Continue magnesium and omega-3s

- **Luteal (PMS):**  
  - Magnesium, calcium, B6-rich foods  
  - Smaller, frequent meals  
  - Limit added salt/sugar  
  - Continue omega-3s and hydration

### **Supplements (if cleared by GP)**
- Magnesium glycinate 200–400mg at night
- Fish oil 1–2g/day
- Iron if deficient
- Vitamin D if needed
